proposals.title: ITEM 7—SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL TO LOWER THE SHARE OWNERSHIP THRESHOLD TO CALL SPECIAL SHAREHOLDER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to let holders of 15% of outstanding common stock call a special shareowner meeting, lowering the current 25% threshold.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" the proposal.
